_comment: Five windows: scene, narration, journal, map, status. Window POSITIONS are fixed here; window SIZES belong to the player (dragged dividers, remembered in user://ui_layout.cfg). Variants are chosen at startup from the real viewport aspect: the best match is the highest min_aspect the viewport still satisfies. Roles a variant omits return null from CoreWindowRegistry - that is the contract.

variants._comment: Landscape. TOP BAND: scene card north-west (the illustrated location), Reach map centre, status north-east. SOUTH BAND, full width: narration and its choice buttons - this is where the player reads and clicks, so it gets the whole width and the majority of the height. The journal sits to its right as a rail, because reliability and conflicts must be readable WHILE reading the prose that argues about them.
Narrow or portrait. One column, narration given the most room; the map is dropped and the journal compresses.
